door.secondOpen: second approach release+100 actual world ticks
door.scope: Native redstone only; normal wait behavior is observed, not assumed to stop an original in-flight path. Bounded current-position owner input forms a real closed-door request without native distance teleport. No maid motion/path/RNG reset.

dimension.scope: One normal request, never bypass upstream override; source-world-preserving refusal is a capability outcome. Port follow-up moves owner through normal SCM, disables destination home, selects the same complete factory and normal stationary ranged task; new controlled target on native5x5 End platform, full original100 cells/tiles restored.
dimension.oldArrow: Registered live arrows must stop after true source exit; old lease cleared without extra payment. Actual collision hook/API failure remains shooter-level protection, ordinary old-source invalidation is arrow-level diagnostic.
dimension.newArrow: Same-UUID live destination actor must naturally emit and update a fresh arrow; old+new joins+remaining ammo==24, durability equals all paid joins.
dimension.retirementObservation: At normal request return, old source may already be dead while native ID map removal is pending. Unique live same-UUID destination actor establishes committed transfer; only the subsequent real source-world END observation checks ID removal/old arrows/lease. No forced map clearing or manually ticked actors.
